Load libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lmtest)
library(lme4)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

set.seed(123)

# -----------------------------
# 1. Create genotype-level data
# -----------------------------

# Population 1: plasticity exists, but is not associated with fitness
AC_summary <- data.frame(
  genotype = paste0("G", 1:6),
  trait_y1 = c(4.8, 5.1, 5.5, 5.0, 5.3, 4.9),
  trait_change = c(0.2, -0.1, 0.15, -0.2, 0.1, -0.05)
) %>%
  mutate(
    population = "Population 1",
    trait_y2 = trait_y1 + trait_change,
    plasticity = (trait_y2 - trait_y1) / abs(trait_y1),
    fitness_y2 = 2.8 + rnorm(n(), 0, 0.18)
  )

# Population 2: plasticity is positively associated with fitness
BO_summary <- data.frame(
  genotype = paste0("G", 1:6),
  trait_y1 = c(4.7, 5.0, 5.2, 4.9, 5.1, 4.8),
  trait_change = c(-0.1, 0.05, 0.25, 0.4, 0.55, 0.7)
) %>%
  mutate(
    population = "Population 2",
    trait_y2 = trait_y1 + trait_change,
    plasticity = (trait_y2 - trait_y1) / abs(trait_y1),
    fitness_y2 = 0.9 + 3.2 * plasticity + rnorm(n(), 0, 0.08)
  )

summary_df <- bind_rows(AC_summary, BO_summary)

# -----------------------------
# 2. Convert to long format for reaction norms
# -----------------------------

reaction_df <- summary_df %>%
  select(population, genotype, trait_y1, trait_y2) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(trait_y1, trait_y2),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "trait"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = dplyr::case_when(
      year == "trait_y1" ~ "Year 1",
      year == "trait_y2" ~ "Year 2",
      TRUE ~ year
    )
  )

# -----------------------------
# 3. Make panels
# -----------------------------

p1 <- ggplot(
  filter(reaction_df, population == "Population 1"),
  aes(x = year, y = trait, group = genotype)
) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "A. Population 1: reaction norms",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Trait value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p2 <- ggplot(
  filter(summary_df, population == "Population 1"),
  aes(x = plasticity, y = fitness_y2)
) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "B. Population 1: fitness relationship",
    x = "Directional plasticity (Year 1 → Year 2)",
    y = "Fitness in Year 2"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p3 <- ggplot(
  filter(reaction_df, population == "Population 2"),
  aes(x = year, y = trait, group = genotype)
) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "C. Population 2: reaction norms",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Trait value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p4 <- ggplot(
  filter(summary_df, population == "Population 2"),
  aes(x = plasticity, y = fitness_y2)
) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "D. Population 2: fitness relationship",
    x = "Directional plasticity (Year 1 → Year 2)",
    y = "Fitness in Year 2"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

# -----------------------------
# 4. Combine and save
# -----------------------------

final_plot <- (p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4)

final_plot

ggsave(
  filename = "figures/conceptual_fig.jpg",
  plot = final_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 1200
)
```


```{r}

set.seed(123)

# -----------------------------
# 1. Theoretical reaction norm data
# -----------------------------

# Population 1: plasticity exists, but not associated with fitness
ac_ids <- paste0("G", 1:6)
ac_2022 <- c(4.8, 5.1, 5.5, 5.0, 5.3, 4.9)
ac_change <- c(0.2, -0.1, 0.15, -0.2, 0.1, -0.05)

AC_reaction <- data.frame(
  genotype = rep(ac_ids, each = 2),
  year = rep(c("Year 1", "Year 2"), times = length(ac_ids)),
  trait = c(rbind(ac_2022, ac_2022 + ac_change))
)

# Population 2: plasticity associated with higher fitness
bo_ids <- paste0("G", 1:6)
bo_2022 <- c(4.7, 5.0, 5.2, 4.9, 5.1, 4.8)
bo_change <- c(-0.1, 0.05, 0.25, 0.4, 0.55, 0.7)

BO_reaction <- data.frame(
  genotype = rep(bo_ids, each = 2),
  year = rep(c("Year 1", "Year 2"), times = length(bo_ids)),
  trait = c(rbind(bo_2022, bo_2022 + bo_change))
)

# -----------------------------
# 2. Theoretical fitness data
# -----------------------------

# Population 1: no relationship
AC_fit <- data.frame(
  plasticity = seq(-0.4, 0.4, length.out = 25),
  fitness_2023 = 2.8 + rnorm(25, 0, 0.18)
)

# Population 2: positive relationship
BO_fit <- data.frame(
  plasticity = seq(-0.4, 0.4, length.out = 25),
  fitness_2023 = 0.9 + 0.55 * seq(-0.4, 0.4, length.out = 25) + rnorm(25, 0, 0.08)
)

# -----------------------------
# 3. Build panels
# -----------------------------

p1 <- ggplot(AC_reaction, aes(x = year, y = trait, group = genotype)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "A. Population 1: reaction norms",
    x = "",
    y = "Trait value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p2 <- ggplot(AC_fit, aes(x = plasticity, y = fitness_2023)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "B. Population 1: fitness consequence",
    x = "Directional plasticity (Year 1 → Year 2)",
    y = expression("Fitness in Year 2")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p3 <- ggplot(BO_reaction, aes(x = year, y = trait, group = genotype)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "C. Population 2: reaction norms",
    x = "",
    y = "Trait value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p4 <- ggplot(BO_fit, aes(x = plasticity, y = fitness_2023)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "D. Population 2: fitness consequence",
    x = "Directional plasticity (Year 1 → Year 2)",
    y = expression("Fitness in Year 2")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

# -----------------------------
# 4. Combine figure
# -----------------------------

final_plot <- (p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4)

final_plot

ggsave("figures/conceptual_fig.jpg", plot = final_plot, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 1200)
```

# ANGELO COAST

Read in the data

```{r Angelo Start}
AC_22 <- read_csv(here::here("data_sheets/compiled_sheets/AC_compiledsheet_full_2022.csv"))
AC_23 <- read_csv(here::here("data_sheets/compiled_sheets/AC_compiledsheet_full_2023.csv"))
```

Create a dataset

```{r}
ac22_trait <- AC_22 %>%
  dplyr::select(Donor, Recipient, F_plant, corolla_diam_mm_SEG, SLA_SEG, d13C_SEG, msm_all) %>% #including maternal and paternal parents
  mutate(Year = "2022") #adding year column

ac23_trait <- AC_23 %>%
  filter(Gen == "G1") %>%    # just include generation 1
  dplyr::select(Donor, Recipient, F_plant, corolla_diam_mm_SEG, SLA_SEG, d13C_SEG, msm_all) %>% #including maternal and paternal parents
  mutate(Year = "2023") #adding year column

# combine years
ac_traits <- bind_rows(ac22_trait, ac23_trait) %>%
filter(F_plant == TRUE)
```

Get paternal family means

```{r}
fam_means <- ac_traits %>%
  group_by(Donor, Year) %>% #all calculations done separately for each paternal family within each year
  summarise(
    across(
      c(corolla_diam_mm_SEG, SLA_SEG, d13C_SEG, msm_all),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), # get the family mean corolla diameter for each Donor × Year, remove NAs
      .names = "mean_{.col}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop" #ungroups the results
  )
```

Assign colors for Increasing and Decreasing

```{r}
dirs_wide <- fam_means %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Year,
    values_from = starts_with("mean_"),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    dir_corolla_diam_mm_SEG = if_else(mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2023 >
                                        mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2022,
                                      "increase", "decrease"),
    dir_SLA_SEG  = if_else(mean_SLA_SEG_2023  > mean_SLA_SEG_2022,
                           "increase", "decrease"),
    dir_d13C_SEG = if_else(mean_d13C_SEG_2023 > mean_d13C_SEG_2022,
                           "increase", "decrease"),
    dir_msm_all  = if_else(mean_msm_all_2023  > mean_msm_all_2022,
                           "increase", "decrease")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Donor, starts_with("dir_"))

#Long format for plotting
fam_long <- fam_means %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("mean_"),
    names_to  = "Trait",
    values_to = "mean_value"
  )

dirs_long <- dirs_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("dir_"),
    names_to  = "Trait",
    values_to = "dir"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Trait = case_when(
      Trait == "dir_corolla_diam_mm_SEG" ~ "corolla diameter (mm)",
      Trait == "dir_SLA_SEG"             ~ "specific leaf area (mm/mg)",
      Trait == "dir_d13C_SEG"            ~ "δ13C (‰)",
      Trait == "dir_msm_all"             ~ "seed mass (mg)",
      TRUE ~ Trait
    )
  )
```

Plot the data
```{r}
plot_dat <- fam_long %>%
  mutate(
    Trait = case_when(
      Trait == "mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG" ~ "corolla diameter (mm)",

p

Pivot the dataframe so each family shows trait means

```{r}
fam_wide <- fam_means %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = Donor,
    names_from = Year,
    values_from = c(mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG, mean_SLA_SEG, mean_d13C_SEG, mean_msm_all)
  )
```

## **1. Is there plasticity in the traits of interest (corolla diameter, sla, d13C, msm)?**

YES. Spearman's Rank Correlations. We will also observe plasticity using the plasticity index as well.

```{r}
# Spearman correlation for corolla area
cor.test(fam_wide$mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2022, fam_wide$mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2023, method = "spearman")
# 	Spearman's rank correlation rho
# 
# data:  fam_wide$mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2022 and fam_wide$mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2023
# S = 8882, p-value = 0.3025
# alternative hypothesis: true rho is not equal to 0
# sample estimates:
#       rho 
# 0.1667917 


# Spearman correlation for SLA
cor.test(fam_wide$mean_SLA_SEG_2022, fam_wide$mean_SLA_SEG_2023, method = "spearman")
# 	Spearman's rank correlation rho
# 
# data:  fam_wide$mean_SLA_SEG_2022 and fam_wide$mean_SLA_SEG_2023
# S = 6828, p-value = 0.2574
# alternative hypothesis: true rho is not equal to 0
# sample estimates:
#       rho 
# 0.1906117 

# Spearman correlation for d13C
cor.test(fam_wide$mean_d13C_SEG_2022, fam_wide$mean_d13C_SEG_2023, method = "spearman")
#	Spearman's rank correlation rho
# 
# data:  fam_wide$mean_d13C_SEG_2022 and fam_wide$mean_d13C_SEG_2023
# S = 7792, p-value = 0.1959
# alternative hypothesis: true rho is not equal to 0
# sample estimates:
#      rho 
# 0.211336

# Spearman correlation for msm
cor.test(fam_wide$mean_msm_all_2022, fam_wide$mean_msm_all_2023, method = "spearman")

# 	Spearman's rank correlation rho
# 
# data:  fam_wide$mean_msm_all_2022 and fam_wide$mean_msm_all_2023
# S = 7790, p-value = 0.1954
# alternative hypothesis: true rho is not equal to 0
# sample estimates:
#       rho 
# 0.2115385
```

## **2. Do traits differ in how plastic they are, on average, across genotypes?**

Calculate how much two traits differ from one another using PIv (Valladares et al., 2006):

```{r}
piv_df <- fam_long %>%
  group_by(Donor, Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    max_mean = max(mean_value, na.rm = TRUE), #determine the maximum donor mean
    min_mean = min(mean_value, na.rm = TRUE), #determine the minimum donor mean
    PIv = (max_mean - min_mean) / abs(max_mean), #calculate the PIv to determine how much traits differ from eachother
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
#determine if trait plasticity is significantly different from zero
piv_tests <- piv_df %>%
  group_by(Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_PIv = mean(PIv, na.rm = TRUE),
    t = t.test(PIv, mu = 0)$statistic,
    p = t.test(PIv, mu = 0)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

piv_tests
```


Calculate plasticity by trait using PIv:

```{r}
mean_piv_by_trait <- piv_df %>%
  group_by(Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_PIv = mean(PIv, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_PIv = sd(PIv, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se_PIv = sd_PIv / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# mean_SLA_SEG
# 0.12840040

# mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG
# 0.08422690

# mean_d13C_SEG
# 0.01515385

# mean_msm_all
# 0.15994703
```

```{r}
#Calculating SE and N
mean_piv_by_trait <- mean_piv_by_trait %>%
  mutate(
    mean_PIv = round(mean_PIv, 3),
    se_PIv = round(se_PIv, 3)
  )

mean_piv_by_trait <- mean_piv_by_trait %>%
  mutate(
    PIv_summary = paste0(mean_PIv, " ± ", se_PIv)
  )

mean_piv_by_trait
```


Calculate how much traits differ from one another using Plmd (used for non-normal distributions):

SLA and msm were slightly non-normal based on histograms earlier.

```{r}

ac_traits_long <- ac_traits %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(corolla_diam_mm_SEG, SLA_SEG, d13C_SEG, msm_all),
    names_to = "Trait",
    values_to = "value"
  )

PImd_df <- ac_traits_long %>%
  group_by(Donor, Trait, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    median_value = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

PImd_df <- PImd_df %>%
  group_by(Donor, Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    max_median = max(median_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_median = min(median_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    PImd = (max_median - min_median) / max_median,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

Do traits differ in how plastic they are, on average, across genotypes? Calculate plasticity by trait:
```{r}
mean_PImd_by_trait <- PImd_df %>%
  group_by(Trait) %>%
  summarise(mean_PImd = mean(PImd, na.rm = TRUE))
```


Comparing PIv and PImd for each trait:

```{r}
# Join the two dataframes by Donor and Trait
piv_df_2 <- piv_df %>%
  mutate(Trait = gsub("mean_", "", Trait))

# Now join and correlate
combined <- inner_join(PImd_df, piv_df_2, by = c("Donor", "Trait"))

cor_by_trait <- combined %>%
  group_by(Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    n   = n(),
    cor = cor.test(PIv, PImd, method = "pearson")$estimate,
    p   = cor.test(PIv, PImd, method = "pearson")$p.value
  )

cor_by_trait
```

## **3. Do the same paternal genotypes differ in mean trait values between years?**

GxY interactions

```{r}
model_null <- lmer(d13C_SEG ~ Year + (1 | Donor) + (1 | Recipient), 
                   data = ac_traits, REML = FALSE)

model_GxY  <- lmer(d13C_SEG ~ Year + (1 | Donor) + (1 | Recipient) + (1 | Donor:Year), 
                   data = ac_traits, REML = FALSE)

vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model_GxY))
total_var <- sum(vc$vcov)
vc$percent <- (vc$vcov / total_var) * 100
vc

# Likelihood ratio test
anova(model_null, model_GxY)

nobs(model_GxY)
summary(model_null)
library(performance)

r2(model_null)
# Conditional R2: 0.151
#      Marginal R2: 0.054
```


```{r}

model_null <- lmer(corolla_diam_mm_SEG ~ Year + (1 | Donor) + (1 | Recipient), 
                   data = ac_traits, REML = FALSE)

model_GxY  <- lmer(corolla_diam_mm_SEG ~ Year + (1 | Donor) + (1 | Recipient) + (1 | Donor:Year), 
                   data = ac_traits, REML = FALSE)

vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model_GxY))
total_var <- sum(vc$vcov)
vc$percent <- (vc$vcov / total_var) * 100
vc

# Likelihood ratio test
anova(model_null, model_GxY)

nobs(model_GxY)

summary(model_null)

r2(model_null)
```

## **4. Across traits, are some paternal families consistently more plastic than others?**

Calculate the overall multivariate plasticity using PIv:

```{r}
mean_piv_by_family <- piv_df %>%
  group_by(Donor) %>%
  summarise(mean_PIv = mean(PIv, na.rm = TRUE))
```

Calculate the overall multivariate plasticity using PImd:

```{r}
mean_PImd_by_family <- PImd_df %>%
  group_by(Donor) %>%
  summarise(mean_PImd = mean(PImd, na.rm = TRUE))
```

Compare and Contrast PImd and PIv:

```{r}
cor.test(mean_PImd_by_family$mean_PImd, mean_piv_by_family$mean_PIv)

# 	Pearson's product-moment correlation
# 
# data:  mean_PImd_by_family$mean_PImd and mean_piv_by_family$mean_PIv
# t = 6.655, df = 38, p-value = 7.231e-08
# alternative hypothesis: true correlation is not equal to 0
# 95 percent confidence interval:
#  0.5471672 0.8507222
# sample estimates:
#       cor 
# 0.7336309 

#Families ranked as highly plastic using PIv are also ranked as highly plastic using PImd
```

## **5. How is a paternal family's trait-specific plasticity as well as it's cross-trait (average) plasticity associated with breeding values for fitness?**

```{r}

AC22_BV<-read.csv("/Users/Helen/Desktop/nemo_field/aster/processed_data/AC22_bhat.Donor.mu.csv")
AC22_BV <- AC22_BV %>%
  rename(Donor = X) %>% 
  rename(BV_W = bhat.Donor.mu) %>% 
  mutate(Donor = sub(".*Donor", "", Donor))


AC23_BV<-read.csv("/Users/Helen/Desktop/nemo_field/aster/processed_data/AC23_bhat.Donor.mu.csv")
AC23_BV <- AC23_BV %>%
  rename(Donor = X) %>%   
  rename(BV_W = bhat.donor.mu) %>% 
  mutate(Donor = sub(".*Donor", "", Donor))

```

Merged the two datasets by Donor for 2022

merged <- AC22_BV %>%

  inner_join(mean_piv_by_family %>% 
               dplyr::select(Donor, mean_PIv),

```

cor_pearson

```

Make a scatterplot of Breeding value (parental effect on W) for Fitness and mean absolute plasticity for 2022

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

  dplyr::select(Donor, BV_W) %>% 
  inner_join(
   mean_piv_by_family %>% dplyr::select(Donor, mean_PIv),

  )

Linear Regression to determine if a correlation exists: \####################################################### Looking at a linear and quadratic model to determine if breeding value for fitness in 2023 and absolute plasticity are correlated:

```{r}

merged_linear <- merged %>% mutate(PIv_c = scale(mean_PIv, scale = FALSE))
model_linear  <- lm(BV_W ~ PIv_c, data = merged_linear)
model_quad <- lm(BV_W ~ PIv_c + I(PIv_c^2), data=merged_linear) #I is for the Identity function

anova(model_linear, model_quad)

# Analysis of Variance Table
# 
# Model 1: BV_W ~ PIv_c
# Model 2: BV_W ~ PIv_c + I(PIv_c^2)
#   Res.Df    RSS Df Sum of Sq      F Pr(>F)
# 1     38 13.255                           
# 2     37 12.574  1   0.68065 2.0029 0.1654

summary(model_linear)
# Call:
# lm(formula = BV_W ~ PIv_c, data = merged_linear)
# 
# Residuals:
#      Min       1Q   Median       3Q      Max 
# -1.22128 -0.43353 -0.04489  0.23642  1.59943 
# 
# Coefficients:
#             Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
# (Intercept)  5.87329    0.09338  62.895   <2e-16 ***
# PIv_c       -3.84671    2.61900  -1.469     0.15    
# ---
# Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
# 
# Residual standard error: 0.5906 on 38 degrees of freedom
# Multiple R-squared:  0.05372,	Adjusted R-squared:  0.02882 
# F-statistic: 2.157 on 1 and 38 DF,  p-value: 0.1501


plot(model_linear)
plot(model_quad)

#vif(model_linear)
#vif(model_quad) 

shapiro.test(residuals(model_linear)) 
shapiro.test(residuals(model_quad)) 

bptest(model_linear)
bptest(model_quad)

#outlierTest(model_linear)
#outlierTest(model_quad)
```

##**7. Does directional plasticity correlate with fitness?
```{r}
# Directional plasticity from 2022 -> 2023
pi_dir <- fam_wide %>%
  mutate(
    PI22_23_corolla = (mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2023 - mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2022) / abs(mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2022),
    PI22_23_SLA     = (mean_SLA_SEG_2023 - mean_SLA_SEG_2022) / abs(mean_SLA_SEG_2022),
    PI22_23_d13C    = (mean_d13C_SEG_2023 - mean_d13C_SEG_2022) / abs(mean_d13C_SEG_2022),
    PI22_23_msm     = (mean_msm_all_2023 - mean_msm_all_2022) / abs(mean_msm_all_2022)
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    mean_PI22_23 = mean(c(PI22_23_corolla, PI22_23_SLA, PI22_23_d13C, PI22_23_msm), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```


```{r}

##STEPS 5-7 AGAIN
## **5. How is a paternal family's trait-specific plasticity as well as it's cross-trait (average) plasticity associated with breeding values for fitness?**

```{r}

AC22_BV<-read.csv("/Users/Helen/Desktop/nemo_field/aster/processed_data/AC22_bhat.Donor.mu.csv")
AC22_BV <- AC22_BV %>%
  rename(Donor = X) %>%

AC23_BV<-read.csv("/Users/Helen/Desktop/nemo_field/aster/processed_data/AC23_bhat.Donor.mu.csv")

  rename(Donor = X) %>%   
  rename(BV_W = bhat.donor.mu) %>% 
  mutate(Donor = sub(".*Donor", "", Donor))

```


Find the change in fitness between 2023 and 2022
```{r}
AC22_BV <- AC22_BV %>% rename(BV_W_2022 = BV_W)
AC23_BV <- AC23_BV %>% rename(BV_W_2023 = BV_W)

# Merge BV data and take the difference
merged_AC <- full_join(AC22_BV, AC23_BV, by = "Donor") %>%
  mutate(delta_BV_W = BV_W_2023 - BV_W_2022)
```

```{r}
# Merge with PIv data, but first pivot

piv_wide <- piv_df %>%
  select(Donor, Trait, PIv) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Trait,
    values_from = PIv
  ) %>%
  rename(
    PIv_SLA = mean_SLA_SEG,
    PIv_corolla = mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG,
    PIv_d13C = mean_d13C_SEG,
    PIv_msm = mean_msm_all
  )

ac_piv <- left_join(merged_AC, piv_wide, by = "Donor")

ac_piv <- ac_piv %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    mean_PIv = mean(c(PIv_corolla, PIv_SLA, PIv_d13C, PIv_msm), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#correlate with trait values

cor.test(ac_piv$delta_BV_W, ac_piv$PIv_SLA)
cor.test(ac_piv$delta_BV_W, ac_piv$PIv_d13C)
cor.test(ac_piv$delta_BV_W, ac_piv$PIv_msm)
cor.test(ac_piv$delta_BV_W, ac_piv$mean_PIv)
```
## **6. Determine if stabalizing selection is acting on plasticity?
Linear Regression to determine if a correlation exists:

Looking at a linear and quadratic model to determine if breeding value for fitness in 2023 and absolute plasticity are correlated:

```{r}

model_linear  <- lm(delta_BV_W ~ mean_PIv, data = ac_piv)
model_quad <- lm(delta_BV_W ~ mean_PIv + I(mean_PIv^2), data= ac_piv)


anova(model_linear, model_quad)

# Analysis of Variance Table
# 
# Model 1: delta_BV_W ~ mean_PIv
# Model 2: delta_BV_W ~ mean_PIv + I(mean_PIv^2)
#   Res.Df    RSS Df Sum of Sq      F Pr(>F)
# 1     38 25.031                           
# 2     37 24.983  1  0.047597 0.0705 0.7921

summary(model_linear)
# Call:
# lm(formula = delta_BV_W ~ mean_PIv, data = ac_piv)
# 
# Residuals:
#      Min       1Q   Median       3Q      Max 
# -2.25110 -0.54952 -0.04041  0.34085  1.90296 
# 
# Coefficients:
#             Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
# (Intercept)  -8.9072     0.3717 -23.962   <2e-16 ***
# mean_PIv     -1.2204     3.5990  -0.339    0.736    
# ---
# Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
# 
# Residual standard error: 0.8116 on 38 degrees of freedom
# Multiple R-squared:  0.003017,	Adjusted R-squared:  -0.02322 
# F-statistic: 0.115 on 1 and 38 DF,  p-value: 0.7364

plot(model_linear)
plot(model_quad)

shapiro.test(residuals(model_linear))
shapiro.test(residuals(model_quad))

bptest(model_linear)
bptest(model_quad)
```

##**7. Does directional plasticity correlate with fitness?
```{r}
# Directional plasticity from 2022 -> 2023
pi_dir <- fam_wide %>%
  mutate(
    PI22_23_corolla = (mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2023 - mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2022) / abs(mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2022),
    PI22_23_SLA     = (mean_SLA_SEG_2023 - mean_SLA_SEG_2022) / abs(mean_SLA_SEG_2022),
    PI22_23_d13C    = (mean_d13C_SEG_2023 - mean_d13C_SEG_2022) / abs(mean_d13C_SEG_2022),
    PI22_23_msm     = (mean_msm_all_2023 - mean_msm_all_2022) / abs(mean_msm_all_2022)
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    mean_PI22_23 = mean(c(PI22_23_corolla, PI22_23_SLA, PI22_23_d13C, PI22_23_msm), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```


```{r}
# Join with directional plasticity data
ac_change <- left_join(merged_AC, pi_dir, by = "Donor")

traits <- c("PI22_23_corolla", "PI22_23_SLA", "PI22_23_d13C", "PI22_23_msm", "mean_PI22_23")

results <- lapply(traits, function(tr) {
  test <- cor.test(ac_change$delta_BV_W, ac_change[[tr]])
  data.frame(
    trait = tr,
    r = unname(test$estimate),
    t = unname(test$statistic),
    p = test$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

results
```


```{r}
#Next, I want to see if BV 2022 is correlated with my change in breeding value, because if it is then we are asking: Do trait changes cause fitness changes? But also indirectly asking do trait changes differ among genotypes with different starting fitness?

cor.test(ac_change$BV_W_2022, ac_change$delta_BV_W)
cor.test(ac_change$BV_W_2023, ac_change$delta_BV_W)


traits <- c("PI22_23_corolla", "PI22_23_SLA", "PI22_23_d13C", "PI22_23_msm", "mean_PI22_23")

model_results <- lapply(traits, function(tr) {
  model <- lm(BV_W_2023 ~ BV_W_2022 + ac_change[[tr]], data = ac_change)
  
  summary_model <- summary(model)
  
  data.frame(
    trait = tr,
    beta = summary_model$coefficients[3,1],
    SE   = summary_model$coefficients[3,2],
    t    = summary_model$coefficients[3,3],
    p    = summary_model$coefficients[3,4]
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    beta = signif(beta, 2),
    SE   = signif(SE, 2),
    t    = signif(t, 2),
    p    = signif(p, 3)
  )

model_results
```

##**9. Do genotypes that differ in plasticity show different changes in fitness between years, after accounting for their overall average fitness across years?
```{r}
# make mean W and change in W
ac_change <- ac_change %>%
  mutate(
    mean_BV_W  = (BV_W_2022 + BV_W_2023) / 2,
    delta_BV_W = BV_W_2023 - BV_W_2022
  )

# run one model for one trait
model_corolla <- lm(delta_BV_W ~ mean_BV_W + PI22_23_corolla, data = ac_change)
summary(model_corolla)

# run all traits at once
traits <- c("PI22_23_corolla", "PI22_23_SLA", "PI22_23_d13C", "PI22_23_msm", "mean_PI22_23")

model_results <- lapply(traits, function(tr) {
  model <- lm(
    reformulate(c("mean_BV_W", tr), response = "delta_BV_W"),
    data = ac_change
  )
  
  sm <- summary(model)
  
  data.frame(
    trait = tr,
    beta_meanW = sm$coefficients["mean_BV_W", "Estimate"],
    t_meanW    = sm$coefficients["mean_BV_W", "t value"],
    p_meanW    = sm$coefficients["mean_BV_W", "Pr(>|t|)"],
    beta_trait = sm$coefficients[tr, "Estimate"],
    t_trait    = sm$coefficients[tr, "t value"],
    p_trait    = sm$coefficients[tr, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    beta_meanW = signif(beta_meanW, 2),
    t_meanW    = signif(t_meanW, 2),
    p_meanW    = signif(p_meanW, 3),
    beta_trait = signif(beta_trait, 2),
    t_trait    = signif(t_trait, 2),
    p_trait    = signif(p_trait, 3)
  )

model_results
```

##**10. Is genotypic mean fitness correlated with trait-specific or multivariate plasticity?

```{r}
traits <- c("PI22_23_corolla", "PI22_23_SLA", "PI22_23_d13C", "PI22_23_msm", "mean_PI22_23")

results <- lapply(traits, function(trait) {

  test <- cor.test(ac_change[[trait]], ac_change$mean_BV_W)

  

  data.frame(

    trait = trait,

    r = round(test$estimate, 2),

    lower_CI = round(test$conf.int[1], 2),

    upper_CI = round(test$conf.int[2], 2),

    p = round(test$p.value, 3)  # usually keep p-values to 3 decimals

  )

})

results_df <- do.call(rbind, results)

results_df
```


```{r}
# Convert to long format
plot_data <- ac_change %>%
  select(all_of(traits), mean_BV_W) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(traits),
    names_to = "trait",
    values_to = "plasticity"
  )

trait_labels <- c(
  PI22_23_corolla = "corolla diameter",
  PI22_23_SLA = "SLA",
  PI22_23_d13C = "δ¹³C",
  PI22_23_msm = "mean seed mass",
  mean_PI22_23 = "multivariate"
)

# Calculate p-values for each trait
sig_traits <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(trait) %>%
  summarise(
    p = cor.test(plasticity, mean_BV_W)$p.value
  ) %>%
  filter(p < 0.05)

# Keep only significant traits for regression lines
smooth_data <- plot_data %>%
  filter(trait %in% sig_traits$trait)

facet_wrap(
  ~ trait,
  scales = "free_x",
  nrow = 1,
  labeller = labeller(trait = trait_labels)
)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = plasticity, y = mean_BV_W)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(
    data = smooth_data,
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ trait,
    scales = "free_x",
    nrow = 1,
    labeller = labeller(trait = trait_labels)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Directional Plasticity",
    y = "Mean W",
    title = "Relationships Between Plasticity and W"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

ggsave("ac_plasticity_BVW_plot.png",
       width = 15,
       height = 3,
       dpi = 300)

BB22_trait <- BB_22 %>%
  dplyr::select(Donor, Recipient, F_plant, corolla_diam_mm_SEG, SLA_SEG, d13C_SEG, msm_all) %>% #including maternal and paternal parents
  mutate(Year = "2022") #adding year column

BB23_trait <- BB_23 %>%
  filter(Gen == "G1") %>%    # just include generation 1
  dplyr::select(Donor, Recipient, F_plant, corolla_diam_mm_SEG, SLA_SEG, d13C_SEG, msm_all) %>% #including maternal and paternal parents
  mutate(Year = "2023") #adding year column

# combine years
BB_traits <- bind_rows(BB22_trait, BB23_trait) %>%
 filter(F_plant == TRUE) 
```

Get paternal family means

```{r}
fam_means <- BB_traits %>%

  summarise(

      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), # get the family mean corolla diameter for each Donor × Year, remove NAs
      .names = "mean_{.col}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop" #ungroups the results
  )

## **1. Is there plasticity in the traits of interest (corolla diameter, SLA, d13C, msm)?**

YES. Spearman's Rank Correlations. We will also observe plasticity using the plasticity index as well.

```{r}
# Spearman correlation for corolla area
cor.test(fam_wide$mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2022, fam_wide$mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2023, method = "spearman")

#

## **2. Do traits differ in how plastic they are, on average, across genotypes?**

Calculate how much two traits differ from one another using PIv (Valladares et al., 2006):

```{r}
piv_df <- fam_long %>%
  group_by(Donor, Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    max_mean = max(mean_value, na.rm = TRUE), #determine the maximum donor mean
    min_mean = min(mean_value, na.rm = TRUE), #determine the minimum donor mean
    PIv = (max_mean - min_mean) / abs(max_mean), #calculate the PIv to determine how much traits differ from eachother
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
#determine if trait plasticity is significantly different from zero
piv_tests <- piv_df %>%
  group_by(Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_PIv = mean(PIv, na.rm = TRUE),
    t = t.test(PIv, mu = 0)$statistic,
    p = t.test(PIv, mu = 0)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

piv_tests
```

```{r}
#determine if trait plasticity is significantly different from zero
piv_tests <- piv_df %>%
  group_by(Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_PIv = mean(PIv, na.rm = TRUE),
    t = t.test(PIv, mu = 0)$statistic,
    p = t.test(PIv, mu = 0)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

piv_tests
```

Calculate plasticity by trait using PIv:

```{r}
mean_piv_by_trait <- piv_df %>%
  group_by(Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_PIv = mean(PIv, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_PIv = sd(PIv, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se_PIv = sd_PIv / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# mean_SLA_SEG
# 0.19641035
# 2
# mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG
# 0.10031997
# 3
# mean_d13C_SEG
# 0.02074321
# 4
# mean_msm_all
# 0.26916701


#Mean seed mass is most plastic
```

```{r}
#Calculating SE and N
mean_piv_by_trait <- mean_piv_by_trait %>%
  mutate(
    mean_PIv = round(mean_PIv, 3),
    se_PIv = round(se_PIv, 3)
  )

mean_piv_by_trait <- mean_piv_by_trait %>%
  mutate(
    PIv_summary = paste0(mean_PIv, " ± ", se_PIv)
  )

mean_piv_by_trait
```

Calculate how much traits differ from one another using Plmd (used for non-normal distributions):

SLA and msm were slightly non-normal based on histograms earlier.

```{r}

BB_traits_long <- BB_traits %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(corolla_diam_mm_SEG, SLA_SEG, d13C_SEG, msm_all),
    names_to = "Trait",
    values_to = "value"
  )

PImd_df <- BB_traits_long %>%
  group_by(Donor, Trait, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    median_value = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

PImd_df <- PImd_df %>%
  group_by(Donor, Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    max_median = max(median_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_median = min(median_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    PImd = (max_median - min_median) / max_median,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

Do traits differ in how plastic they are, on average, across genotypes? Calculate plasticity by trait:

```{r}
mean_PImd_by_trait <- PImd_df %>%
  group_by(Trait) %>%
  summarise(mean_PImd = mean(PImd, na.rm = TRUE))


#SLA_SEG
# 0.18273880
# 
# corolla_diam_mm_SEG
# 0.11388103
# 
# d13C_SEG
# -0.02491601
# 
# msm_all
# 0.27613576
```

Comparing PIv and PImd:
```{r}
# Join the two dataframes by Donor and Trait
piv_df_2 <- piv_df %>%
  mutate(Trait = gsub("mean_", "", Trait))

# Now join and correlate
combined <- inner_join(PImd_df, piv_df_2, by = c("Donor", "Trait"))

cor_by_trait <- combined %>%
  group_by(Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    n   = n(),
    cor = cor.test(PIv, PImd, method = "pearson")$estimate,
    p   = cor.test(PIv, PImd, method = "pearson")$p.value
  )

cor_by_trait
```

## **3. Do the same paternal genotypes differ in mean trait values between years?**

GxY interactions

```{r}
model_null <- lmer(d13C_SEG ~ Year + (1 | Donor) + (1 | Recipient), 
                   data = BB_traits, REML = FALSE)

model_GxY  <- lmer(d13C_SEG ~ Year + (1 | Donor) + (1 | Recipient) + (1 | Donor:Year), 
                   data = BB_traits, REML = FALSE)

vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model_GxY))
total_var <- sum(vc$vcov)
vc$percent <- (vc$vcov / total_var) * 100
vc

# Likelihood ratio test
anova(model_null, model_GxY)

nobs(model_GxY)

summary(model_null)

r2(model_null)
```

mean_piv_by_family <- piv_df %>%
  group_by(Donor) %>%
  summarise(mean_PIv = mean(PIv, na.rm = TRUE))
```

Calculate the overall multivariate plasticity using PImd:

```{r}
mean_PImd_by_family <- PImd_df %>%
  group_by(Donor) %>%
  summarise(mean_PImd = mean(PImd, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
cor.test(mean_PImd_by_family$mean_PImd, mean_piv_by_family$mean_PIv)

#	Pearson's product-moment correlation
#

# alternative hypothesis: true correlation is not equal to 0
# 95 percent confidence interval:
#  0.6104362 0.8584909
# sample estimates:
#       cor 
# 0.7610044

Linear Regression to determine if a correlation exists: \####################################################### Looking at a linear and quadratic model to determine if breeding value for fitness in 2023 and absolute plasticity are correlated:

```{r}

merged_linear <- merged %>% mutate(PIv_c = scale(mean_PIv, scale = FALSE))
model_linear  <- lm(BV_W ~ PIv_c, data = merged_linear)
model_quad <- lm(BV_W ~ PIv_c + I(PIv_c^2), data=merged_linear)

anova(model_linear, model_quad)

# Analysis of Variance Table
# 
# Model 1: BV_W ~ PIv_c
# Model 2: BV_W ~ PIv_c + I(PIv_c^2)
#   Res.Df    RSS Df Sum of Sq      F Pr(>F)
# 1     47 565.44                           
# 2     46 563.04  1    2.3917 0.1954 0.6605

summary(model_linear)
#Call:
# lm(formula = BV_W ~ PIv_c, data = merged_linear)
# 
# Residuals:
#     Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
# -4.5421 -2.6343 -0.6986  1.9111 11.4696 
# 
# Coefficients:
#             Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
# (Intercept)  15.3921     0.4955  31.064   <2e-16 ***
# PIv_c        -2.5454     8.9166  -0.285    0.777    
# ---
# Signif. codes:  
# 0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
# 
# Residual standard error: 3.469 on 47 degrees of freedom
# Multiple R-squared:  0.001731,	Adjusted R-squared:  -0.01951 
# F-statistic: 0.08149 on 1 and 47 DF,  p-value: 0.7765

plot(model_linear)
plot(model_quad)

#vif(model_linear)
#vif(model_quad) 

shapiro.test(residuals(model_linear)) #not normal
shapiro.test(residuals(model_quad)) #not normal

bptest(model_linear)
bptest(model_quad)

#outlierTest(model_linear)
#outlierTest(model_quad)

##**7. Does directional plasticity correlate with fitness?
```{r}
# Directional plasticity from 2022 -> 2023
pi_dir <- fam_wide %>%
  mutate(
    PI22_23_corolla = (mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2023 - mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2022) / abs(mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2022),
    PI22_23_SLA     = (mean_SLA_SEG_2023 - mean_SLA_SEG_2022) / abs(mean_SLA_SEG_2022),
    PI22_23_d13C    = (mean_d13C_SEG_2023 - mean_d13C_SEG_2022) / abs(mean_d13C_SEG_2022),
    PI22_23_msm     = (mean_msm_all_2023 - mean_msm_all_2022) / abs(mean_msm_all_2022)
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    mean_PI22_23 = mean(c(PI22_23_corolla, PI22_23_SLA, PI22_23_d13C, PI22_23_msm), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## **5. How is a paternal family's trait-specific plasticity as well as it's cross-trait (average) plasticity associated with breeding values for fitness?**

```{r}

BB22_BV<-read.csv("/Users/Helen/Desktop/nemo_field/aster/processed_data/BB22_bhat.Donor.mu.csv")
BB22_BV <- BB22_BV %>%
  rename(Donor = X) %>% 
  rename(BV_W = bhat.Donor.mu) %>% 
  mutate(Donor = sub(".*Donor", "", Donor))


BB23_BV<-read.csv("/Users/Helen/Desktop/nemo_field/aster/processed_data/BB23_bhat.Donor.mu.csv")
BB23_BV <- BB23_BV %>%
  rename(Donor = X) %>%   
  rename(BV_W = bhat.donor.mu) %>% 
  mutate(Donor = sub(".*Donor", "", Donor))

```


Find the change in fitness between 2023 and 2022
```{r}
BB22_BV <- BB22_BV %>% rename(BV_W_2022 = BV_W)
BB23_BV <- BB23_BV %>% rename(BV_W_2023 = BV_W)

# Merge BV data and take the difference
merged_BB <- full_join(BB22_BV, BB23_BV, by = "Donor") %>%
  mutate(delta_BV_W = BV_W_2023 - BV_W_2022)
```

```{r}
# Merge with PIv data, but first pivot

piv_wide <- piv_df %>%
  select(Donor, Trait, PIv) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Trait,
    values_from = PIv
  ) %>%
  rename(
    PIv_SLA = mean_SLA_SEG,
    PIv_corolla = mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG,
    PIv_d13C = mean_d13C_SEG,
    PIv_msm = mean_msm_all
  )

BB_piv <- left_join(merged_BB, piv_wide, by = "Donor")

BB_piv <- BB_piv %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    mean_PIv = mean(c(PIv_corolla, PIv_SLA, PIv_d13C, PIv_msm), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
traits <- c("PIv_corolla", "PIv_SLA", "PIv_d13C", "PIv_msm", "mean_PIv")

results <- lapply(traits, function(tr) {
  test <- cor.test(BB_piv$delta_BV_W, BB_piv[[tr]])
  
  data.frame(
    trait = tr,
    r = unname(test$estimate),
    t = unname(test$statistic),
    p = test$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    r = round(r, 2),
    t = round(t, 2),
    p = signif(p, 3)
  )

results
```

plot(model_quad)

##**7. Does directional plasticity correlate with fitness?
```{r}
# Directional plasticity from 2022 -> 2023
pi_dir <- fam_wide %>%
  mutate(
    PI22_23_corolla = (mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2023 - mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2022) / abs(mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2022),
    PI22_23_SLA     = (mean_SLA_SEG_2023 - mean_SLA_SEG_2022) / abs(mean_SLA_SEG_2022),
    PI22_23_d13C    = (mean_d13C_SEG_2023 - mean_d13C_SEG_2022) / abs(mean_d13C_SEG_2022),
    PI22_23_msm     = (mean_msm_all_2023 - mean_msm_all_2022) / abs(mean_msm_all_2022)
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    mean_PI22_23 = mean(c(PI22_23_corolla, PI22_23_SLA, PI22_23_d13C, PI22_23_msm), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```


```{r}
# Join with directional plasticity data
BB_change <- left_join(merged_BB, pi_dir, by = "Donor")

traits <- c("PI22_23_corolla", "PI22_23_SLA", "PI22_23_d13C", "PI22_23_msm", "mean_PI22_23")

results <- lapply(traits, function(tr) {
  test <- cor.test(BB_change$delta_BV_W, BB_change[[tr]])
  data.frame(
    trait = tr,
    r = unname(test$estimate),
    t = unname(test$statistic),
    p = test$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    r = round(r, 2),
    t = round(t, 2),
    p = signif(p, 3)
  )

results
```

```{r}
#Next, I want to see if BV 2022 is correlated with my change in breeding value, because if it is then we are asking: Do trait changes cause fitness changes? But also indirectly asking do trait changes differ among genotypes with different starting fitness?

cor.test(BB_change$BV_W_2022, BB_change$delta_BV_W)
cor.test(BB_change$BV_W_2023, BB_change$delta_BV_W)


traits <- c("PI22_23_corolla", "PI22_23_SLA", "PI22_23_d13C", "PI22_23_msm", "mean_PI22_23")

model_results <- lapply(traits, function(tr) {
  model <- lm(BV_W_2023 ~ BV_W_2022 + BB_change[[tr]], data = BB_change)
  
  summary_model <- summary(model)
  
  data.frame(
    trait = tr,
    beta = summary_model$coefficients[3,1],
    SE   = summary_model$coefficients[3,2],
    t    = summary_model$coefficients[3,3],
    p    = summary_model$coefficients[3,4]
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    beta = signif(beta, 2),
    SE   = signif(SE, 2),
    t    = signif(t, 2),
    p    = signif(p, 3)
  )

model_results
```

##**9. Do genotypes that differ in plasticity show different changes in fitness between years, after accounting for their overall average fitness across years?

```{r}
# make mean W and change in W
BB_change <- BB_change %>%
  mutate(
    mean_BV_W  = (BV_W_2022 + BV_W_2023) / 2,
    delta_BV_W = BV_W_2023 - BV_W_2022
  )

# run one model for one trait
model_corolla <- lm(delta_BV_W ~ mean_BV_W + PI22_23_corolla, data = BB_change)
summary(model_corolla)

# run all traits at once
traits <- c("PI22_23_corolla", "PI22_23_SLA", "PI22_23_d13C", "PI22_23_msm", "mean_PI22_23")

model_results <- lapply(traits, function(tr) {
  model <- lm(
    reformulate(c("mean_BV_W", tr), response = "delta_BV_W"),
    data = BB_change
  )
  
  sm <- summary(model)
  
  data.frame(
    trait = tr,
    beta_meanW = sm$coefficients["mean_BV_W", "Estimate"],
    t_meanW    = sm$coefficients["mean_BV_W", "t value"],
    p_meanW    = sm$coefficients["mean_BV_W", "Pr(>|t|)"],
    beta_trait = sm$coefficients[tr, "Estimate"],
    t_trait    = sm$coefficients[tr, "t value"],
    p_trait    = sm$coefficients[tr, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    beta_meanW = signif(beta_meanW, 2),
    t_meanW    = signif(t_meanW, 2),
    p_meanW    = signif(p_meanW, 3),
    beta_trait = signif(beta_trait, 2),
    t_trait    = signif(t_trait, 2),
    p_trait    = signif(p_trait, 3)
  )

model_results
```

```{r}
# Convert to long format
plot_data <- BB_change %>%
  select(all_of(traits), mean_BV_W) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(traits),
    names_to = "trait",
    values_to = "plasticity"

trait_labels <- c(
  PI22_23_corolla = "corolla diameter",

)

# Calculate p-values for each trait
sig_traits <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(trait) %>%
  summarise(
    p = cor.test(plasticity, mean_BV_W)$p.value
  ) %>%
  filter(p < 0.05)

# Keep only significant traits for regression lines
smooth_data <- plot_data %>%
  filter(trait %in% sig_traits$trait)

facet_wrap(
  ~ trait,
  scales = "free_x",
  nrow = 1,
  labeller = labeller(trait = trait_labels)
)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = plasticity, y = mean_BV_W)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +

    labeller = labeller(trait = trait_labels)
  ) +

  ) +

ggsave("BB_plasticity_BVW_plot.png",

##**10. Is genotypic mean fitness correlated with trait-specific or multivariate plasticity?

```{r}
traits <- c("PI22_23_corolla", "PI22_23_SLA", "PI22_23_d13C", "PI22_23_msm", "mean_PI22_23")

results <- lapply(traits, function(trait) {

  test <- cor.test(BB_change[[trait]], BB_change$mean_BV_W)

  

  data.frame(

    trait = trait,

    r = round(test$estimate, 2),

    lower_CI = round(test$conf.int[1], 2),

    upper_CI = round(test$conf.int[2], 2),

    p = round(test$p.value, 3)  # usually keep p-values to 3 decimals

  )

})

results_df <- do.call(rbind, results)

results_df
```

#BLUE OAK

```{r}
# BLUE OAK

Read in the data
"BB_051" "BB_215" "BB_171"
```{r}
BO_22 <- read_csv(here::here("data_sheets/compiled_sheets/BO_compiledsheet_full_2022.csv"))
BO_23 <- read_csv(here::here("data_sheets/compiled_sheets/BO_compiledsheet_full_2023.csv"))
```

Create a dataset

```{r}
BO22_trait <- BO_22 %>%
  dplyr::select(Donor, Recipient, F_plant, corolla_diam_mm_SEG, SLA_SEG, d13C_SEG, msm_all) %>% #including maternal and paternal parents
  mutate(Year = "2022") #adding year column

BO23_trait <- BO_23 %>%
  filter(Gen == "G1") %>%    # just include generation 1
  dplyr::select(Donor, Recipient, F_plant, corolla_diam_mm_SEG, SLA_SEG, d13C_SEG, msm_all) %>% #including maternal and paternal parents
  mutate(Year = "2023") #adding year column

#REMOVING THIS ONE ODD OUTLIER WHICH WAS LIKELY A MISTAKE
BO23_trait <- BO23_trait %>%
  mutate(SLA_SEG = ifelse(Donor == "BO_194" &
                          Recipient == "BO_098",
                          NA,
                          SLA_SEG))

# combine years
BO_traits <- bind_rows(BO22_trait, BO23_trait) %>%
  filter(F_plant == TRUE)
```

Get paternal family means

```{r}
fam_means <- BO_traits %>%
  group_by(Donor, Year) %>% #all calculations done separately for each paternal family within each year
  summarise(
    across(
      c(corolla_diam_mm_SEG, SLA_SEG, d13C_SEG, msm_all),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), # get the family mean corolla diameter for each Donor × Year, remove NAs
      .names = "mean_{.col}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop" #ungroups the results
  )

```

Assign colors for Increasing and Decreasing

```{r}
dirs_wide <- fam_means %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Year,
    values_from = starts_with("mean_"),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    dir_corolla_diam_mm_SEG = if_else(mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2023 >
                                        mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2022,
                                      "increase", "decrease"),
    dir_SLA_SEG  = if_else(mean_SLA_SEG_2023  > mean_SLA_SEG_2022,
                           "increase", "decrease"),
    dir_d13C_SEG = if_else(mean_d13C_SEG_2023 > mean_d13C_SEG_2022,
                           "increase", "decrease"),
    dir_msm_all  = if_else(mean_msm_all_2023  > mean_msm_all_2022,
                           "increase", "decrease")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Donor, starts_with("dir_"))

#Long format for plotting
fam_long <- fam_means %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("mean_"),
    names_to  = "Trait",
    values_to = "mean_value"
  )

dirs_long <- dirs_wide %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("dir_"),
    names_to  = "Trait",
    values_to = "dir"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Trait = case_when(
      Trait == "dir_corolla_diam_mm_SEG" ~ "corolla diameter (mm)",
      Trait == "dir_SLA_SEG"             ~ "specific leaf area (mm/mg)",
      Trait == "dir_d13C_SEG"            ~ "δ13C (‰)",
      Trait == "dir_msm_all"             ~ "seed mass (mg)",
      TRUE ~ Trait
    )
  )
```


Plot the data

```{r}

## **2. Do traits differ in how plastic they are, on average, across genotypes?**

Calculate how much two traits differ from one another using PIv (Valladares et al., 2006):

```{r}
piv_df <- fam_long %>%
  group_by(Donor, Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    max_mean = max(mean_value, na.rm = TRUE), #determine the maximum donor mean
    min_mean = min(mean_value, na.rm = TRUE), #determine the minimum donor mean
    PIv = (max_mean - min_mean) / abs(max_mean), #calculate the PIv to determine how much traits differ from eachother
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
#determine if trait plasticity is significantly different from zero
piv_tests <- piv_df %>%
  group_by(Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_PIv = mean(PIv, na.rm = TRUE),
    t = t.test(PIv, mu = 0)$statistic,
    p = t.test(PIv, mu = 0)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

piv_tests
```

Calculate plasticity by trait using PIv:

```{r}
mean_piv_by_trait <- piv_df %>%
  group_by(Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_PIv = mean(PIv, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_PIv = sd(PIv, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se_PIv = sd_PIv / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# mean_SLA_SEG
# 0.11008189
# 
# mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG
# 0.11343378
# 
# mean_d13C_SEG
# 0.04560326
# 
# mean_msm_all
# 0.28343208

#Mean seed mass is most plastic
```

```{r}
#Calculating SE and N
mean_piv_by_trait <- mean_piv_by_trait %>%
  mutate(
    mean_PIv = round(mean_PIv, 3),
    se_PIv = round(se_PIv, 3)
  )

mean_piv_by_trait <- mean_piv_by_trait %>%
  mutate(
    PIv_summary = paste0(mean_PIv, " ± ", se_PIv)
  )

mean_piv_by_trait
```

Calculate how much traits differ from one another using Plmd (used for non-normal distributions):

SLA and msm were slightly non-normal based on histograms earlier.

```{r}

BO_traits_long <- BO_traits %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(corolla_diam_mm_SEG, SLA_SEG, d13C_SEG, msm_all),
    names_to = "Trait",
    values_to = "value"
  )

PImd_df <- BO_traits_long %>%
  group_by(Donor, Trait, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    median_value = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

PImd_df <- PImd_df %>%
  group_by(Donor, Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    max_median = max(median_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_median = min(median_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    PImd = (max_median - min_median) / max_median,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

Do traits differ in how plastic they are, on average, across genotypes? Calculate plasticity by trait:

```{r}
mean_PImd_by_trait <- PImd_df %>%
  group_by(Trait) %>%
  summarise(mean_PImd = mean(PImd, na.rm = TRUE))

# 
# SLA_SEG
# 0.10258560
# 
# corolla_diam_mm_SEG
# 0.11685655
# 
# d13C_SEG
# -0.04541372
# 
# msm_all
# 0.28806691
```

Comparing PIv and PImd:

```{r}

# Join the two dataframes by Donor and Trait
piv_df_2 <- piv_df %>%
  mutate(Trait = gsub("mean_", "", Trait))

# Now join and correlate
combined <- inner_join(PImd_df, piv_df_2, by = c("Donor", "Trait"))

cor_by_trait <- combined %>%
  group_by(Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    n   = n(),
    cor = cor.test(PIv, PImd, method = "pearson")$estimate,
    p   = cor.test(PIv, PImd, method = "pearson")$p.value
  )

cor_by_trait
```

## **3. Do the same paternal genotypes differ in mean trait values between years?**

GxY interactions

```{r}
model_null <- lmer(d13C_SEG ~ Year + (1 | Donor) + (1 | Recipient), 
                   data = BO_traits, REML = FALSE)

model_GxY  <- lmer(d13C_SEG ~ Year + (1 | Donor) + (1 | Recipient) + (1 | Donor:Year), 
                   data = BO_traits, REML = FALSE)

vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model_GxY))
total_var <- sum(vc$vcov)
vc$percent <- (vc$vcov / total_var) * 100
vc

# Likelihood ratio test
anova(model_null, model_GxY)

nobs(model_GxY)

summary(model_null)

r2(model_null)
```

Linear Regression to determine if a correlation exists: \####################################################### Looking at a linear and quadratic model to determine if breeding value for fitness in 2023 and absolute plasticity are correlated:

```{r}
merged_linear <- merged %>% mutate(PIv_c = scale(mean_PIv, scale = FALSE))
model_linear  <- lm(BV_W ~ PIv_c, data = merged_linear)
model_quad <- lm(BV_W ~ PIv_c + I(PIv_c^2), data=merged_linear)

anova(model_linear, model_quad)

#Analysis of Variance Table
# 
# Model 1: BV_W ~ mean_PIv
# Model 2: BV_W ~ mean_PIv + I(mean_PIv^2)
#   Res.Df    RSS Df Sum of Sq     F Pr(>F)
# 1     42 2.0793                          
# 2     41 2.0793  1 9.017e-06 2e-04 0.9894

##the linear model is better than the quadratic

summary(model_linear)
#Call:
# lm(formula = BV_W ~ mean_PIv, data = merged)
# 
# Residuals:
#      Min       1Q   Median       3Q      Max 
# -0.31353 -0.14221 -0.02386  0.08100  0.74839 
# 
# Coefficients:
#             Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
# (Intercept)   1.7520     0.0754  23.235   <2e-16 ***
# mean_PIv      0.2936     0.5855   0.501    0.619    
# ---
# Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
# 
# Residual standard error: 0.2225 on 42 degrees of freedom
# Multiple R-squared:  0.005952,	Adjusted R-squared:  -0.01772 
# F-statistic: 0.2515 on 1 and 42 DF,  p-value: 0.6186

plot(model_linear)
plot(model_quad)

#vif(model_linear)
#vif(model_quad) #multicolinear...

shapiro.test(residuals(model_linear)) #not normal
shapiro.test(residuals(model_quad)) #not normal

bptest(model_linear)
bptest(model_quad)

#outlierTest(model_linear)
#outlierTest(model_quad)
```

Looking at a linear and quadratic model to determine if breeding value for fitness in 2023 and plasticity in corolla diameter are correlated:

```{r}

merged_corolla <- merged_corolla %>% mutate(PIv_c = scale(PIv, scale = FALSE))
model_linear  <- lm(BV_W ~ PIv_c, data = merged_corolla)
model_quad    <- lm(BV_W ~ PIv_c + I(PIv^2), data = merged_corolla)


anova(model_linear, model_quad)
#Analysis of Variance Table
# 
# Model 1: BV_W ~ PIv
# Model 2: BV_W ~ PIv + I(PIv^2)
#   Res.Df     RSS Df Sum of Sq      F Pr(>F)
# 1     42 0.51208                           
# 2     41 0.49935  1  0.012724 1.0448 0.3127

summary(model_linear)

# Call:
# lm(formula = BV_W ~ PIv, data = merged_corolla)
# 
# Residuals:
#      Min       1Q   Median       3Q      Max 
# -0.14548 -0.08550 -0.02175  0.05684  0.34568 
# 
# Coefficients:
#             Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
# (Intercept)  0.62990    0.03177  19.829   <2e-16 ***
# PIv          0.04844    0.23851   0.203     0.84    
# ---
# Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
# 
# Residual standard error: 0.1104 on 42 degrees of freedom
# Multiple R-squared:  0.000981,	Adjusted R-squared:  -0.02281 
# F-statistic: 0.04124 on 1 and 42 DF,  p-value: 0.84

plot(model_linear)
plot(model_quad)

#vif(model_linear)
#vif(model_quad) #multicolinear..

shapiro.test(residuals(model_linear)) #non-normal
shapiro.test(residuals(model_quad)) #non-normal

bptest(model_linear)
bptest(model_quad)

#outlierTest(model_linear)
#outlierTest(model_quad)

##**7. Does directional plasticity correlate with fitness?
```{r}
# Directional plasticity from 2022 -> 2023
pi_dir <- fam_wide %>%
  mutate(
    PI22_23_corolla = (mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2023 - mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2022) / abs(mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2022),
    PI22_23_SLA     = (mean_SLA_SEG_2023 - mean_SLA_SEG_2022) / abs(mean_SLA_SEG_2022),
    PI22_23_d13C    = (mean_d13C_SEG_2023 - mean_d13C_SEG_2022) / abs(mean_d13C_SEG_2022),
    PI22_23_msm     = (mean_msm_all_2023 - mean_msm_all_2022) / abs(mean_msm_all_2022)
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    mean_PI22_23 = mean(c(PI22_23_corolla, PI22_23_SLA, PI22_23_d13C, PI22_23_msm), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```


```{r}

## **5. How is a paternal family's trait-specific plasticity as well as it's cross-trait (average) plasticity associated with breeding values for fitness?**

```{r}

BO22_BV<-read.csv("/Users/Helen/Desktop/nemo_field/aster/processed_data/BO22_bhat.Donor.mu.csv")
BO22_BV <- BO22_BV %>%
  rename(Donor = X) %>% 
  rename(BV_W = bhat.Donor.mu) %>% 
  mutate(Donor = sub(".*Donor", "", Donor))


BO23_BV<-read.csv("/Users/Helen/Desktop/nemo_field/aster/processed_data/BO23_bhat.Donor.mu.csv")
BO23_BV <- BO23_BV %>%
  rename(Donor = X) %>%   
  rename(BV_W = bhat.donor.mu) %>% 
  mutate(Donor = sub(".*Donor", "", Donor))

```


Find the change in fitness between 2023 and 2022
```{r}
BO22_BV <- BO22_BV %>% rename(BV_W_2022 = BV_W)
BO23_BV <- BO23_BV %>% rename(BV_W_2023 = BV_W)

# Merge BV data and take the difference
merged_BO <- full_join(BO22_BV, BO23_BV, by = "Donor") %>%
  mutate(delta_BV_W = BV_W_2023 - BV_W_2022)
```

```{r}
# Merge with PIv data, but first pivot

piv_wide <- piv_df %>%
  select(Donor, Trait, PIv) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Trait,
    values_from = PIv
  ) %>%
  rename(
    PIv_SLA = mean_SLA_SEG,
    PIv_corolla = mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG,
    PIv_d13C = mean_d13C_SEG,
    PIv_msm = mean_msm_all
  )

BO_piv <- left_join(merged_BO, piv_wide, by = "Donor")

BO_piv <- BO_piv %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    mean_PIv = mean(c(PIv_corolla, PIv_SLA, PIv_d13C, PIv_msm), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
traits <- c("PIv_corolla", "PIv_SLA", "PIv_d13C", "PIv_msm", "mean_PIv")

results <- lapply(traits, function(tr) {
  test <- cor.test(BO_piv$delta_BV_W, BO_piv[[tr]])
  
  data.frame(
    trait = tr,
    r = unname(test$estimate),
    t = unname(test$statistic),
    p = test$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    r = round(r, 2),
    t = round(t, 2),
    p = signif(p, 3)
  )

results
```

pi_dir <- fam_wide %>%

    PI22_23_corolla = (mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2023 - mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2022) / abs(mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2022),
    PI22_23_SLA     = (mean_SLA_SEG_2023 - mean_SLA_SEG_2022) / abs(mean_SLA_SEG_2022),
    PI22_23_d13C    = (mean_d13C_SEG_2023 - mean_d13C_SEG_2022) / abs(mean_d13C_SEG_2022),
    PI22_23_msm     = (mean_msm_all_2023 - mean_msm_all_2022) / abs(mean_msm_all_2022)
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    mean_PI22_23 = mean(c(PI22_23_corolla, PI22_23_SLA, PI22_23_d13C, PI22_23_msm), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```


```{r}
# Join with directional plasticity data
BO_change <- left_join(merged_BO, pi_dir, by = "Donor")

traits <- c("PI22_23_corolla", "PI22_23_SLA", "PI22_23_d13C", "PI22_23_msm", "mean_PI22_23")

results <- lapply(traits, function(tr) {
  test <- cor.test(BO_change$delta_BV_W, BO_change[[tr]])
  data.frame(
    trait = tr,
    r = unname(test$estimate),
    t = unname(test$statistic),
    p = test$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    r = round(r, 2),
    t = round(t, 2),
    p = signif(p, 2)
  )

results
```

##**9. Do genotypes that differ in plasticity show different changes in fitness between years, after accounting for their overall average fitness across years?

```{r}
# make mean W and change in W
BO_change <- BO_change %>%
  mutate(
    mean_BV_W  = (BV_W_2022 + BV_W_2023) / 2,
    delta_BV_W = BV_W_2023 - BV_W_2022
  )

# run one model for one trait
model_corolla <- lm(delta_BV_W ~ mean_BV_W + PI22_23_corolla, data = BO_change)
summary(model_corolla)

# run all traits at once
traits <- c("PI22_23_corolla", "PI22_23_SLA", "PI22_23_d13C", "PI22_23_msm", "mean_PI22_23")

model_results <- lapply(traits, function(tr) {
  model <- lm(
    reformulate(c("mean_BV_W", tr), response = "delta_BV_W"),
    data = BO_change
  )
  
  sm <- summary(model)
  
  data.frame(
    trait = tr,
    beta_meanW = sm$coefficients["mean_BV_W", "Estimate"],
    t_meanW    = sm$coefficients["mean_BV_W", "t value"],
    p_meanW    = sm$coefficients["mean_BV_W", "Pr(>|t|)"],
    beta_trait = sm$coefficients[tr, "Estimate"],
    t_trait    = sm$coefficients[tr, "t value"],
    p_trait    = sm$coefficients[tr, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    beta_meanW = signif(beta_meanW, 2),
    t_meanW    = signif(t_meanW, 2),
    p_meanW    = signif(p_meanW, 3),
    beta_trait = signif(beta_trait, 2),
    t_trait    = signif(t_trait, 2),
    p_trait    = signif(p_trait, 3)
  )

model_results
```

HR22_trait <- HR_22 %>%

## **1. Is there plasticity in the traits of interest (corolla diameter, SLA, d13C, msm)?**

YES. Spearman's Rank Correlations. We will also observe plasticity using the plasticity index as well.

```{r}
# Spearman correlation for corolla area
cor.test(fam_wide$mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2022, fam_wide$mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2023, method = "spearman")
#	Spearman's rank correlation rho
# 
# data:  fam_wide$mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2022 and fam_wide$mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2023
# S = 13074, p-value = 0.1965
# alternative hypothesis: true rho is not equal to 0
# sample estimates:
#       rho 
# 0.1937095 


# Spearman correlation for SLA **SIGNIFICANT CORRELATION**
cor.test(fam_wide$mean_SLA_SEG_2022, fam_wide$mean_SLA_SEG_2023, method = "spearman")

# 	Spearman's rank correlation rho
# 
# data:  fam_wide$mean_SLA_SEG_2022 and fam_wide$mean_SLA_SEG_2023
# S = 15466, p-value = 0.9022
# alternative hypothesis: true rho is not equal to 0
# sample estimates:
#         rho 
# -0.01884058

# Spearman correlation for d13C
cor.test(fam_wide$mean_d13C_SEG_2022, fam_wide$mean_d13C_SEG_2023, method = "spearman")
# 	Spearman's rank correlation rho
# 
# data:  fam_wide$mean_d13C_SEG_2022 and fam_wide$mean_d13C_SEG_2023
# S = 5570.4, p-value = 3.065e-06
# alternative hypothesis: true rho is not equal to 0
# sample estimates:
#       rho 
# 0.6330457 

# Spearman correlation for msm
cor.test(fam_wide$mean_msm_all_2022, fam_wide$mean_msm_all_2023, method = "spearman")

#	Spearman's rank correlation rho
#
# data:  fam_wide$mean_msm_all_2022 and fam_wide$mean_msm_all_2023
# S = 11998, p-value = 0.08106
# alternative hypothesis: true rho is not equal to 0
# sample estimates:
#       rho 
# 0.2600678
```

## **2. Do traits differ in how plastic they are, on average, across genotypes?**

Calculate how much two traits differ from one another using PIv (Valladares et al., 2006):

```{r}
piv_df <- fam_long %>%
  group_by(Donor, Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    max_mean = max(mean_value, na.rm = TRUE), #determine the maximum donor mean
    min_mean = min(mean_value, na.rm = TRUE), #determine the minimum donor mean
    PIv = (max_mean - min_mean) / abs(max_mean), #calculate the PIv to determine how much traits differ from eachother
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
#determine if trait plasticity is significantly different from zero
piv_tests <- piv_df %>%
  group_by(Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_PIv = mean(PIv, na.rm = TRUE),
    t = t.test(PIv, mu = 0)$statistic,
    p = t.test(PIv, mu = 0)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

piv_tests
```

Calculate plasticity by trait using PIv:

```{r}
mean_piv_by_trait <- piv_df %>%
  group_by(Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_PIv = mean(PIv, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_PIv = sd(PIv, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se_PIv = sd_PIv / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# mean_SLA_SEG
# 0.12559425
# 
# mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG
# 0.05634288
# 
# mean_d13C_SEG
# 0.01180732
# 
# mean_msm_all
# 0.21584238


#Mean seed mass is most plastic
```

```{r}
#Calculating SE and N
mean_piv_by_trait <- mean_piv_by_trait %>%
  mutate(
    mean_PIv = round(mean_PIv, 3),
    se_PIv = round(se_PIv, 3)
  )

mean_piv_by_trait <- mean_piv_by_trait %>%
  mutate(
    PIv_summary = paste0(mean_PIv, " ± ", se_PIv)
  )

mean_piv_by_trait
```

Calculate how much traits differ from one another using Plmd (used for non-normal distributions):

SLA and msm were slightly non-normal based on histograms earlier.

```{r}

HR_traits_long <- HR_traits %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(corolla_diam_mm_SEG, SLA_SEG, d13C_SEG, msm_all),
    names_to = "Trait",
    values_to = "value"
  )

PImd_df <- HR_traits_long %>%
  group_by(Donor, Trait, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    median_value = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

PImd_df <- PImd_df %>%
  group_by(Donor, Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    max_median = max(median_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_median = min(median_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    PImd = (max_median - min_median) / max_median,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

Do traits differ in how plastic they are, on average, across genotypes? Calculate plasticity by trait:

```{r}
mean_PImd_by_trait <- PImd_df %>%
  group_by(Trait) %>%
  summarise(mean_PImd = mean(PImd, na.rm = TRUE))

# SLA_SEG
# 0.13051724
# 
# corolla_diam_mm_SEG
# 0.05848524
# 
# d13C_SEG
# -0.01212758
# 
# msm_all
# 0.21967071
```

Comparing PIv and PImd:

```{r}
# Join the two dataframes by Donor and Trait
piv_df_2 <- piv_df %>%
  mutate(Trait = gsub("mean_", "", Trait))

# Now join and correlate
combined <- inner_join(PImd_df, piv_df_2, by = c("Donor", "Trait"))

cor_by_trait <- combined %>%
  group_by(Trait) %>%
  summarise(
    n   = n(),
    cor = cor.test(PIv, PImd, method = "pearson")$estimate,
    p   = cor.test(PIv, PImd, method = "pearson")$p.value
  )

cor_by_trait
```
## **3. Do the same paternal genotypes differ in mean trait values between years?**

GxY interactions

```{r}
model_null <- lmer(d13C_SEG ~ Year + (1 | Donor) + (1 | Recipient), 
                   data = HR_traits, REML = FALSE)

model_GxY  <- lmer(d13C_SEG ~ Year + (1 | Donor) + (1 | Recipient) + (1 | Donor:Year), 
                   data = HR_traits, REML = FALSE)

vc <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(model_GxY))
total_var <- sum(vc$vcov)
vc$percent <- (vc$vcov / total_var) * 100
vc

# Likelihood ratio test
anova(model_null, model_GxY)

nobs(model_GxY)

summary(model_null)

r2(model_null)

```

## **4. Across traits, are some paternal families consistently more plastic than others?**

Calculate the overall multivariate plasticity using PIv:

```{r}
mean_piv_by_family <- piv_df %>%
  group_by(Donor) %>%
  summarise(mean_PIv = mean(PIv, na.rm = TRUE))
```

Calculate the overall multivariate plasticity using PImd:

```{r}
mean_PImd_by_family <- PImd_df %>%
  group_by(Donor) %>%
  summarise(mean_PImd = mean(PImd, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
cor.test(mean_PImd_by_family$mean_PImd, mean_piv_by_family$mean_PIv)

#Pearson's product-moment correlation
# 
# data:  mean_PImd_by_family$mean_PImd and mean_piv_by_family$mean_PIv
# t = 6.9007, df = 44, p-value = 1.599e-08
# alternative hypothesis: true correlation is not equal to 0
# 95 percent confidence interval:
#  0.5446230 0.8362254
# sample estimates:
#       cor 
# 0.7209385

```

Linear Regression to determine if a correlation exists: \####################################################### Looking at a linear and quadratic model to determine if breeding value for fitness in 2023 and absolute plasticity are correlated:

```{r}
merged_linear <- merged %>% mutate(PIv_c = scale(mean_PIv, scale = FALSE))
model_linear  <- lm(BV_W ~ PIv_c, data = merged_linear)
model_quad <- lm(BV_W ~ PIv_c + I(PIv_c^2), data=merged_linear)


anova(model_linear, model_quad)

#Analysis of Variance Table
# 
# Model 1: BV_W ~ mean_PIv
# Model 2: BV_W ~ mean_PIv + I(mean_PIv^2)
#   Res.Df    RSS Df  Sum of Sq     F Pr(>F)
# 1     44 23.079                           
# 2     43 23.079  1 0.00026648 5e-04 0.9823

##the linear model is better than the quadratic

summary(model_linear)
#Call:
# lm(formula = BV_W ~ mean_PIv, data = merged)
# 
# Residuals:
#      Min       1Q   Median       3Q      Max 
# -1.08929 -0.50429 -0.09806  0.39300  1.65211 
# 
# Coefficients:
#             Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
# (Intercept)   3.2730     0.2749  11.906 2.36e-15 ***
# mean_PIv     -5.0437     2.6254  -1.921   0.0612 .  
# ---
# Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
# 
# Residual standard error: 0.7242 on 44 degrees of freedom
# Multiple R-squared:  0.07739,	Adjusted R-squared:  0.05642 
# F-statistic: 3.691 on 1 and 44 DF,  p-value: 0.06121

plot(model_linear)
plot(model_quad)

#vif(model_linear)
#vif(model_quad) #multicolinear...

shapiro.test(residuals(model_linear)) # normal enough
shapiro.test(residuals(model_quad)) #not normal

bptest(model_linear)
bptest(model_quad)

#outlierTest(model_linear)
#outlierTest(model_quad)
```

## **5. How is a paternal family's trait-specific plasticity as well as it's cross-trait (average) plasticity associated with breeding values for fitness?**

```{r}

HR22_BV<-read.csv("/Users/Helen/Desktop/nemo_field/aster/processed_data/HR22_bhat.Donor.mu.csv")

  mutate(Donor = sub(".*Donor", "", Donor))


HR23_BV<-read.csv("/Users/Helen/Desktop/nemo_field/aster/processed_data/HR23_bhat.Donor.mu.csv")

  rename(Donor = X) %>%   
  rename(BV_W = bhat.donor.mu) %>% 
  mutate(Donor = sub(".*Donor", "", Donor))

```


Find the change in fitness between 2023 and 2022
```{r}
HR22_BV <- HR22_BV %>% rename(BV_W_2022 = BV_W)
HR23_BV <- HR23_BV %>% rename(BV_W_2023 = BV_W)

# Merge BV data and take the difference
merged_HR <- full_join(HR22_BV, HR23_BV, by = "Donor") %>%
  mutate(delta_BV_W = BV_W_2023 - BV_W_2022)
```

```{r}
# Merge with PIv data, but first pivot

piv_wide <- piv_df %>%
  select(Donor, Trait, PIv) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Trait,
    values_from = PIv
  ) %>%
  rename(
    PIv_SLA = mean_SLA_SEG,
    PIv_corolla = mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG,
    PIv_d13C = mean_d13C_SEG,
    PIv_msm = mean_msm_all
  )

HR_piv <- left_join(merged_HR, piv_wide, by = "Donor")

HR_piv <- HR_piv %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    mean_PIv = mean(c(PIv_corolla, PIv_SLA, PIv_d13C, PIv_msm), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
traits <- c("PIv_corolla", "PIv_SLA", "PIv_d13C", "PIv_msm", "mean_PIv")

results <- lapply(traits, function(tr) {
  test <- cor.test(HR_piv$delta_BV_W, HR_piv[[tr]])
  
  data.frame(
    trait = tr,
    r = unname(test$estimate),
    t = unname(test$statistic),
    p = test$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    r = round(r, 2),
    t = round(t, 2),
    p = signif(p, 3)
  )

results
```
## **6. Determine if stabalizing selection is acting on plasticity?
Linear Regression to determine if a correlation exists:

Looking at a linear and quadratic model to determine if breeding value for fitness in 2023 and absolute plasticity are correlated:

```{r}

model_linear  <- lm(delta_BV_W ~ mean_PIv, data = HR_piv)
model_quad <- lm(delta_BV_W ~ mean_PIv + I(mean_PIv^2), data= HR_piv)


anova(model_linear, model_quad)

#Analysis of Variance Table
# 
# Model 1: delta_BV_W ~ mean_PIv
# Model 2: delta_BV_W ~ mean_PIv + I(mean_PIv^2)
#   Res.Df    RSS Df Sum of Sq      F Pr(>F)
# 1     44 23.641                           
# 2     43 23.425  1    0.2155 0.3956 0.5327

summary(model_linear)
# Call:
# lm(formula = delta_BV_W ~ mean_PIv, data = HR_piv)
# 
# Residuals:
#      Min       1Q   Median       3Q      Max 
# -1.76785 -0.47141 -0.07144  0.54459  1.66541 
# 
# Coefficients:
#             Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
# (Intercept)  -7.6432     0.2936 -26.036   <2e-16 ***
# mean_PIv     -4.4396     2.6655  -1.666    0.103    
# ---
# Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
# 
# Residual standard error: 0.733 on 44 degrees of freedom
# Multiple R-squared:  0.05931,	Adjusted R-squared:  0.03793 
# F-statistic: 2.774 on 1 and 44 DF,  p-value: 0.1029

plot(model_linear)
plot(model_quad)

shapiro.test(residuals(model_linear))
shapiro.test(residuals(model_quad))

bptest(model_linear)
bptest(model_quad)
```

```{r}
# Join with directional plasticity data
HR_change <- left_join(merged_HR, pi_dir, by = "Donor")

traits <- c("PI22_23_corolla", "PI22_23_SLA", "PI22_23_d13C", "PI22_23_msm", "mean_PI22_23")

results <- lapply(traits, function(tr) {
  test <- cor.test(HR_change$delta_BV_W, HR_change[[tr]])
  data.frame(
    trait = tr,
    r = unname(test$estimate),
    t = unname(test$statistic),
    p = test$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

    r = round(r, 2),
    t = round(t, 2),
    p = signif(p, 2)
  )

```{r}
#Next, I want to see if BV 2022 is correlated with my change in breeding value, because if it is then we are asking: Do trait changes cause fitness changes? But also indirectly asking do trait changes differ among genotypes with different starting fitness?

cor.test(HR_change$BV_W_2022, HR_change$delta_BV_W)
cor.test(HR_change$BV_W_2023, HR_change$delta_BV_W)

traits <- c("PI22_23_corolla", "PI22_23_SLA", "PI22_23_d13C", "PI22_23_msm", "mean_PI22_23")


model_results <- lapply(traits, function(tr) {
  model <- lm(BV_W_2023 ~ BV_W_2022 + HR_change[[tr]], data = HR_change)
  
  summary_model <- summary(model)
  
  data.frame(
    trait = tr,
    beta = summary_model$coefficients[3,1],
    SE   = summary_model$coefficients[3,2],
    t    = summary_model$coefficients[3,3],
    p    = summary_model$coefficients[3,4]
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    beta = signif(beta, 2),
    SE   = signif(SE, 2),
    t    = signif(t, 2),
    p    = signif(p, 3)
  )

model_results
```


##**8. Uno reverse
```{r}
# Directional plasticity: Year 1 – Year 2
pi_dir_rev <- fam_wide %>%
  mutate(
    PI23_22_corolla = (mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2022 - mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2023) / abs(mean_corolla_diam_mm_SEG_2023),
    PI23_22_SLA     = (mean_SLA_SEG_2022 - mean_SLA_SEG_2023) / abs(mean_SLA_SEG_2023),
    PI23_22_d13C    = (mean_d13C_SEG_2022 - mean_d13C_SEG_2023) / abs(mean_d13C_SEG_2023),
    PI23_22_msm     = (mean_msm_all_2022 - mean_msm_all_2023) / abs(mean_msm_all_2023)
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    mean_PI23_22 = mean(c(PI23_22_corolla, PI23_22_SLA, PI23_22_d13C, PI23_22_msm), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
HR_model <- left_join(merged_HR, pi_dir_rev, by = "Donor")

##**9. Do genotypes that differ in plasticity show different changes in fitness between years, after accounting for their overall average fitness across years?
```{r}
# make mean W and change in W
HR_change <- HR_change %>%
  mutate(
    mean_BV_W  = (BV_W_2022 + BV_W_2023) / 2,
    delta_BV_W = BV_W_2023 - BV_W_2022
  )

# run one model for one trait
model_corolla <- lm(delta_BV_W ~ mean_BV_W + PI22_23_corolla, data = HR_change)
summary(model_corolla)

# run all traits at once
traits <- c("PI22_23_corolla", "PI22_23_SLA", "PI22_23_d13C", "PI22_23_msm", "mean_PI22_23")

model_results <- lapply(traits, function(tr) {
  model <- lm(
    reformulate(c("mean_BV_W", tr), response = "delta_BV_W"),
    data = HR_change
  )
  
  sm <- summary(model)
  
  data.frame(
    trait = tr,
    beta_meanW = sm$coefficients["mean_BV_W", "Estimate"],
    t_meanW    = sm$coefficients["mean_BV_W", "t value"],
    p_meanW    = sm$coefficients["mean_BV_W", "Pr(>|t|)"],
    beta_trait = sm$coefficients[tr, "Estimate"],
    t_trait    = sm$coefficients[tr, "t value"],
    p_trait    = sm$coefficients[tr, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    beta_meanW = signif(beta_meanW, 2),
    t_meanW    = signif(t_meanW, 2),
    p_meanW    = signif(p_meanW, 3),
    beta_trait = signif(beta_trait, 2),
    t_trait    = signif(t_trait, 2),
    p_trait    = signif(p_trait, 3)
  )

model_results
```

```{r}
# Convert to long format
plot_data <- HR_change %>%
  select(all_of(traits), mean_BV_W) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(traits),
    names_to = "trait",
    values_to = "plasticity"
  )

trait_labels <- c(
  PI22_23_corolla = "corolla diameter",
  PI22_23_SLA = "SLA",
  PI22_23_d13C = "δ¹³C",
  PI22_23_msm = "mean seed mass",
  mean_PI22_23 = "multivariate"
)

# Calculate p-values for each trait
sig_traits <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(trait) %>%
  summarise(
    p = cor.test(plasticity, mean_BV_W)$p.value
  ) %>%
  filter(p < 0.05)

# Keep only significant traits for regression lines
smooth_data <- plot_data %>%
  filter(trait %in% sig_traits$trait)

facet_wrap(
  ~ trait,
  scales = "free_x",
  nrow = 1,
  labeller = labeller(trait = trait_labels)
)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = plasticity, y = mean_BV_W)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(
    data = smooth_data,
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ trait,
    scales = "free_x",
    nrow = 1,
    labeller = labeller(trait = trait_labels)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Directional Plasticity",
    y = "Mean W",
    title = "Relationships Between Plasticity and W"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

ggsave("HR_plasticity_BVW_plot.png",
       width = 15,
       height = 3,
       dpi = 300)

```

##**10. Is genotypic mean fitness correlated with trait-specific or multivariate plasticity?

```{r}
traits <- c("PI22_23_corolla", "PI22_23_SLA", "PI22_23_d13C", "PI22_23_msm", "mean_PI22_23")

results <- lapply(traits, function(trait) {

  test <- cor.test(HR_change[[trait]], HR_change$mean_BV_W)

  

  data.frame(

    trait = trait,

    r = round(test$estimate, 2),

    lower_CI = round(test$conf.int[1], 2),

    upper_CI = round(test$conf.int[2], 2),

    p = round(test$p.value, 3)  # usually keep p-values to 3 decimals

  )

})

results_df <- do.call(rbind, results)

results_df
```

##**11. deltaCarbon13&SLA
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(grid)

# one row per Donor, with start and end points
arrow_data <- HR_change %>%
  select(
    Donor,
    mean_SLA_SEG_2022,
    mean_SLA_SEG_2023,
    mean_d13C_SEG_2022,
    mean_d13C_SEG_2023
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_SLA = mean_SLA_SEG_2023 - mean_SLA_SEG_2022,
    delta_d13C = mean_d13C_SEG_2023 - mean_d13C_SEG_2022
  )

# point data for 2022 and 2023
point_data <- HR_change %>%
  select(
    Donor,
    mean_SLA_SEG_2022,
    mean_SLA_SEG_2023,
    mean_d13C_SEG_2022,
    mean_d13C_SEG_2023
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_SLA_SEG_2022, mean_SLA_SEG_2023,
             mean_d13C_SEG_2022, mean_d13C_SEG_2023),
    names_to = c("Trait", "Year"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_(2022|2023)",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Trait,
    values_from = value
  )

ggplot() +
  geom_segment(
    data = arrow_data,
    aes(
      x = mean_d13C_SEG_2022,
      y = mean_SLA_SEG_2022,
      xend = mean_d13C_SEG_2023,
      yend = mean_SLA_SEG_2023,
      color = delta_SLA
    ),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "cm")),
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = point_data,
    aes(
      x = mean_d13C_SEG,
      y = mean_SLA_SEG,
      shape = Year
    ),
    size = 2.8,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("2022" = 16, "2023" = 17)) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "orange",
    mid = "grey70",
    high = "blue",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = expression(Delta*"SLA")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(delta^{13}*C),
    y = "SLA",
    title = expression("Plasticity trajectories in SLA and " * delta^{13} * "C")
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
  )

ggsave("HR_SLA_d13_plot.png",
       width = 15,
       height = 5,
       dpi = 300)
```
